integrity: The five-point kernel derives algebraically from quadratic least squares; the finite certificates exhaust all binary cuts in n<=8 and are supported by a separate proof of the coarea reduction and universal analytic bounds. No independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact Gini norm known here only for cyclic n=5,6,7,8; universal bounds and strict-amplification witnesses hold for every n>=5. No formula for exact fixed-size n>=9, nonperiodic endpoints, longer windows, unequal weights or other seminorms. The same-model originality judgment is qualified by possibility of unindexed equivalent historical analysis.
title: An eight-site boundary for Gini stability of cyclic five-point Savitzky–Golay smoothing
